rationale: DESeq2 Wald on raw Salmon gene counts for an unpaired 6 vs 6 single-batch design is correct, with edgeR QL as a stated robustness check. QC is complete: blind VST PCA, distance heatmap, per-sample library size and detected genes, sample_01 kept, inspected, reported by name, and probed by a sensitivity refit rather than silently dropped. Filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples), median-of-ratios inside the model, explicit chow reference, named contrast, apeglm shrinkage, and BH at 0.05 with independent filtering are all stated; the design formula is described rather than written out, and one constraint line ('test_against_threshold') conflicts with the stated no-LFC-threshold policy. Enrichment correctly uses the mouse MSigDB Hallmark collection with release stated, fgsea on the full Wald-statistic-ranked list, size window 15-500, and universe = tested genes, avoiding the human-sets-on-mouse-symbols error. The report specifies method, versions, design, thresholds, n_tested/n_DE, NA-cause counts, length-offset caveat, and a reproducibility record with seeds.
